name: trumpet
description:
Connect Claude directly to your trumpet workspace and work with your Pods without leaving Claude. Build new Pods, search your Template library, pull live engagement data, surface stakeholder activity and deal health insights. All from a single prompt.
Perfect for prepping before a call, building a Pod mid-conversation, tracking deal momentum, and knowing exactly where to focus next.

_published_faq.name: How do I add trumpet to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add trumpet to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://trumpet.app/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the trumpet MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: trumpet provides these MCP tools: create-pod, fetch, search, search-templates, and update-pod-variables.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to trumpet?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to trumpet in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
trumpet requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
trumpet is developed by trumpet. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
